verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec, and a probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt index, markdown doc mirrors and the MCP server are related AI-facing features, but none is an API specification, so none earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
